context: The line comes after a violent confrontation in which Lae'zel — the strange, hostile warrior the tieflings had been facing — has just been killed. The speaker is one of the tieflings who fought her and is expressing relief and finality now that the threat is dead. This scene follows a prior choice-heavy sequence where the party could have tried to capture, kill, or hand Lae'zel over, so the comment reflects one possible outcome (her death). Related nearby wreckage and dying foes (e.g., a mind flayer) or other dead victims may be present in surrounding scenes, but those details vary by playthrough.
